---
title: "Teds_EDA"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor) 
library(naniar)
library(here)
options(scipen = 99)
```

```{r}
TedsA <- load(here("data/tedsa_puf_2023.rdata"))

teds_a <- get(TedsA) %>%
  clean_names()

teds_hi <- teds_a %>%
  filter(stfips == 15)
```

Decode Age

```{r}
teds_hi <- teds_hi %>%
  mutate(age_lbl = factor(age,
                               levels = 1:12,
                               labels = c("12-14 years ", 
                                          "15-17 years",
                                          "18-20 years",
                                          "21-24 years",
                                          "25-29 years",
                                          "30-34 years",
                                          "35-39 years",
                                          "40-44 years",
                                          "45-49 years",
                                          "50-54 years",
                                          "55-64 years",
                                          "65 years and older")))
```

Decode ALCDRUG

```{r}
teds_hi <- teds_hi %>%
  mutate(alcdrug_lbl = factor(alcdrug,
                          levels = 0:3,
                          labels = c("None", 
                                     "Alcohol only",
                                     "Other Drugs Only",
                                     "Alcohol and other drugs")))
```

```{r}
ggplot(teds_hi, aes(x = age_lbl)) + 
  geom_bar(fill = "blue4", color = "black" ) + 
  facet_wrap(~alcdrug_lbl)+
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

```
